snippet_primary: "Si te ganas $10.000 al mes con Hotmart, tendrás que pagar cerca de $1.000 al mes por usar la plataforma. Estarás pagando mucho más si estás vendiendo un gran número de ofertas debido a su comisión de 50c por venta."
subject_exact: Systeme.io (competitor) claims that at $10,000/month revenue on Hotmart, creators pay ~$1,000/month (~10%) in platform fees, plus $0.50 per individual transaction
metric_value_raw: ~10% of revenue ($1,000/month at $10,000/month); $0.50 per sale additional
local_qualifiers: systeme.io competitor marketing page; figures presented to favor systeme.io as Hotmart alternative
parser_notes: systeme.io/hotmart-alternative (undated, evergreen). Competitor page claims Hotmart effective cost ~$1,000/month at $10,000 revenue (10%) plus $0.50/sale. Competitor-motivated figures; not verified against Hotmart's official pricing.
